COMPONENT_SET.findingAsWritten: The specification data/record-clearing/packet-specifications/MS-nonconviction-expungement-99-19-71-4.v1.json, bound by SHA-256 in this family's own product-wiring.json, names five documents. Four mapped to manifest components and rendered. The fifth, ms-cover-and-contents, role cover_and_contents, order 1, requirement required, mapped to manifestComponentIds [] and nothing rendered it, so the delivered 8-page packet opened directly on the petition with no cover, no packet-contents list, no records-to-have-beside-you summary and no signing-and-notarization page. requiredComponentsMissing read 0 because the counter compares the delivered pages against the build's own rendered-artifacts.json componentSet, which declared exactly the four documents it rendered.
COMPONENT_SET.howItWasRepaired: ms-cover-and-contents is now a composed component, cover_and_contents, at order 1, rendered as packet pages 1-2 of both fixtures and carrying the four things the specification's document definition requires - the cover, the packet contents in delivery order, the records to have beside you, and the signing-and-notarization page - in the participant-facing register the packet already uses. The component set is now measured against the specification and not against the build's own report of itself: the builder declares, per specification document, either which composed components render it or an explicit disposition with a stated reason, and the shared host asserts at build time that every specification document is accounted for, that every named component is one this family declares, and that every named component actually reaches a page in EVERY fixture, reading each fixture's own page manifest rather than the component list the build intended.
